title: Thursday Quick Tip
subtitle: Clear jobs for volunteers
hook: Three parents volunteered. What does each one do?
intro: Parents say they want to help.
No one is quite sure how.
statement: Volunteers stay when they know their job.
q1: Do you hand out a short list of jobs early —
q2: or ask for help as needs come up?
q3: Which jobs do you end up doing yourself?
t1: Both can work. But help shows up
t2: when each person has one clear job.
cta: Coaches — how do you organize volunteers?
ctaLines: A list up front or ask as you go?
ctaPrompt: Share your volunteer habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
Three parents volunteered. What does each one do?
Parents say they want to help. No one is quite sure how.
Volunteers stay when they know their job.
Assign jobs early or ask as needs come up. Both can work.
How do you organize volunteers? Share your habit in the comments.
